verdict.rationale:
Docs show multiple official SDK-style integrations: a Python client (client.source_connections.create), LlamaIndex tool spec, Vercel AI SDK package, Pipedream actions, plus an OpenAPI spec and CLI/MCP server for programmatic access, directly supporting AI-native building against Airweave.
Missing for 10: a clearly named general-purpose language SDK (e.g., Node/TS) beyond framework-specific packages, and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality.
